content.text: I fixed the bug by changing one line in `solution/util.py`, and the visible suite now passes (3 tests). The parser `_parse_field` returns each field's set of allowed values plus a "restricted" flag. That flag should be `False` only when the field is a bare `*`, but it also came back `False` for every explicit value, list, range or step. Because of that, `day_ok` in `solution/core.py` saw both the day-of-month and day-of-week fields as unrestricted and matched every day. That explains the failures: `0 0 * * 0` returned the next day instead of the next Sunday, and `0 0 13 * *` returned Jan 6 instead of the 13th. Making the non-`*` path return `True` fixes it, and I left `core.py` alone. One thing to know: when both day fields are restricted, `core.py` requires both to match. Standard Vixie/POSIX cron fires if either one matches. No test covers that case and the issue doesn't mention it, so I kept the existing behaviour, but it's the next place to look if the hidden suite expects standard cron.
